alt: 少年在關閉的房門外緊握雙手，緊張地坐在等候椅上。
scene_prompt: Outside a closed audition room, an anxious teenager sits at the edge of a waiting bench, shoulders tense, knees close, fingers nervously clasped and gaze worriedly darting toward the door. Their backpack is on floor and one heel raised as if fidgeting. Another calm waiting person provides contrast in background. Clearly unsettled anticipation, no literal numbers, no written signs.
